name: Glassfruit Strand
concept: translucent fruit grove, colored sea-glass dunes, shell fans, clear tidal pools, coral arches, giant split glassfruit pavilion
prompt: Original richly detailed crisp pixel art for LeafTale, Korean-style fantasy RPG. Region Glassfruit Strand. Theme: translucent fruit grove, colored sea-glass dunes, shell fans, clear tidal pools, coral arches, giant split glassfruit pavilion. TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC ISOMETRIC camera:45degree azimuth,30degree elevation, 2:1 ground diamonds with symmetric left/right axes. NOT a top-down picture rotated diagonally. Deliberate native pixel clusters, fine local-color contours, rich warm/cool 3D shading, no blur or thick black outlines. Transparent background. No characters, UI, letters or numbers. TERRAIN atlas EXACTLY4columns x4rows of SIXTEEN separate 2:1 diamond ground tiles. Wide2:1 canvas approximately1792x896px. Each cell448x224px, each diamond nearly fills its cell with a little clear margin, no tile crossing. First TWO rows are EIGHT variants of WALKABLE pale peach sand with restrained colored sea-glass flecks; last TWO rows are EIGHT variants of BLOCKED luminous shallow aquamarine sea with tiny underwater shells. Maintain one cohesive material palette across all eight variants of a material. Quiet tiny texture details, subtle stones, tufts, shells, footprints appropriate to theme. FLAT ground only: NO trees, houses, tall rocks, large objects, isolated huge icons or floating terrain slabs. All tiles have same scale and lighting and clean silhouette and minimal contact edges. Artwork already drawn in proper 2:1 isometric diamond perspective.
